verdict.rationale: Bugbot can apply team conventions, but only through manually written rules: `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files and admin-created org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations. It also reads existing comments on the current PR so it builds on prior feedback and avoids duplicates. Nothing shows it builds a persistent, learned memory of past review decisions across PRs. Missing for 10: automatic learning of conventions from past reviews, cross-PR memory of accepted/rejected suggestions, and independent corroboration of any memory behavior.
